verification: 151 focused tests passed in one regression run. All 7,296 planned real moves completed. Every prior control record, including learned-state and action/outcome digests, reproduced exactly apart from timing.

limits: Usefulness evidence is not used for automatic selection or maturity.
All assigned outcomes enter the estimate, not only activations.
Adaptive access value is not lifetime topology value or final ablation effect.
Reused development seeds and a short window do not establish reliable superiority.

interpretation: All six probed trials completed 128 assigned actual episodes. Disabled participation was zero in every arm. History stayed action-bound, original shadow histories remained frozen, and evaluation changed no learned evidence.

Generic planted fixtures distinguish a useful AND (enabled-minus-disabled reward 2) from a success-correlated but action-irrelevant condition (difference 0), while ordinary bias and participating candidate weights remain plastic. This is mechanism evidence, not chess discovery.

Validation none/always-ranked/always-random/probed-ranked/probed-random: seed 1 126/126/128/122/126; seed 2 93/101/101/94/94; seed 3 66/66/66/66/66. Half-time probing reduced or matched final performance in every comparison with the corresponding always-enabled arm.

Enabled-minus-disabled reward means were +0.069404, -0.004894 and -0.034744 for seeds 1,2,3, identical for ranked/random within each seed. Propensity-weighted contrasts were +0.03125, -0.03125 and -0.0625. These short signals did not establish reliable usefulness discrimination in chess.

Seed 2 probed policies scored 94; masking the candidate raised the score to 117 (27 actions changed, 2 mates lost, 25 gained). The same definition helped under always-enabled training (101 to 91 when masked). Usefulness depends on the surrounding learned policy and learning history.

Seed 1's two probed candidates produced identical suffix action/outcome digests and identical reward estimates despite different live participations (1 versus 36) and final validation (122 versus 126). The estimator cannot distinguish candidates from identical observed histories.

No probed candidate improved final validation when unmasked versus its own masked clone: seed 1 and 3 were unchanged; seed 2 was harmed by it. This is final-policy dependence, not a retrospective estimate of value throughout training.

Do not promote 50% probing, threshold these estimates into maturity/pruning, or claim a new self-organizing selection policy. The evidence signal is not yet used to decide retention. Keep always-enabled training as the experimental reference.

Next recommended bounded work: a matched recovery/stability run with a fixed additional always-enabled training interval and all ordinary learning mechanisms unchanged. Determine whether the regression persists before adding a usefulness-driven controller. Longer runs may invoke existing pruning; report that rather than attributing recovery solely to edge updates.
Final test remains closed. No strategic handover, general growth regulation, long-run retention or full M1/KRK mastery was established.
